description: Global South - Renewable energy share in simulated mini-grids is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Catherina Cader (Reiner Lemoine Institut). The data set provides information on the renewable energy share of area-wide mini-grid (PV-battery-diesel) optimizations minimizing LCOE in all countries with a rural electrification rate below 90%. The values are renewable energy in percent of the total energy production. Full information on the creation of the data set can be found here:. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean. It has 3 files in TIFF, GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Energy access, Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
